definitions.label: Auto-archive after (new agency)
definitions.description: Months without activity after which the daily lifecycle run archives a client: the value a new agency starts with, and the window of an agency with no settings row.

definitions.label: Auto-archive: longest an owner may set
definitions.description: The longest auto-archive window an agency owner may set on Settings > Data and privacy (inside the database bounds 12 to 120 months).

definitions.label: Auto-archive: shortest an owner may set
definitions.description: The shortest auto-archive window an agency owner may set on Settings > Data and privacy (inside the database bounds 12 to 120 months).

definitions.label: Discount owner limit of a new agency
definitions.description: A proposal discount above this percent needs the owner's approval. The value a new agency starts with (the owner changes it on Settings > Pricing, 0 to 100 %).

definitions.label: Retail markup ceiling
definitions.description: The highest default retail markup an agency owner may set per AA product type on Settings > Retail markup (from 0 %).

definitions.label: Book now price checks of a new agency
definitions.description: Book now price checks a minute an agency's page takes from every address together: the value a new agency starts with, and the ceiling of an agency with no settings row.

definitions.label: Book now price checks: highest an owner may set
definitions.description: The highest Book now price checks a minute an agency owner may set on Settings > Online booking (inside the database bounds 10 to 600).

definitions.label: Book now price checks: lowest an owner may set
definitions.description: The lowest Book now price checks a minute an agency owner may set on Settings > Online booking (inside the database bounds 10 to 600).

definitions.label: Trash window of a new agency
definitions.description: Days a deleted record stays restorable before the daily lifecycle run purges it: the value a new agency starts with, and the window of an agency with no settings row.

definitions.label: Trash window: longest an owner may set
definitions.description: The longest trash window an agency owner may set on Settings > Data and privacy (inside the database bounds 1 to 30 days).

definitions.label: Trash window: shortest an owner may set
definitions.description: The shortest trash window an agency owner may set on Settings > Data and privacy (inside the database bounds 1 to 30 days).

definitions.label: Agency services: disclaimer printed under the agency's own services
definitions.description: The sentence printed under the group "Services provided by <agency>" (flights, visa, travel insurance, the agency fee) on the client's proposal (page, e-mail text, PDF) and invoice (printable page and PDF), one text per language: {"en": "...", "vi": "..."}. It tells the client that the agency, not Adventure Asia, provides and answers for these services. An administrator may give one agency its own wording. Read by app/ledger/agency_extras.py.

default_value.en: These services are arranged and provided by the agency named above, which is responsible for them. Airline, visa and insurance terms are those of the airline, the issuing authority and the insurer.
default_value.vi: Các dịch vụ này do đại lý nêu trên sắp xếp, cung cấp và chịu trách nhiệm. Điều kiện vé máy bay, thị thực và bảo hiểm theo quy định của hãng bay, cơ quan cấp thị thực và công ty bảo hiểm.

definitions.label: Agency services: days before a deadline that its task opens
definitions.description: An agency's own service line (flight, visa, travel insurance, agency fee) can carry a deadline: the flight's ticketing time limit, the visa file's submission date, the day to buy the insurance. The hourly workflow tick opens one task for the trip owner when a planning or requested line comes within this many days of its deadline (0 = on the day). An administrator may give one agency its own value. Read by app/ledger/agency_extras.py (the task: app/ledger/agency_due.py).

definitions.label: AI budget of a new agency
definitions.description: The monthly AI budget of an agency whose CRM plan gives no AI budget (CIS feature crm.ai_budget_usd_monthly on the Plans page wins when set), and of an agency with no settings row yet. Never above the agency's ceiling (the lower of the two applies).

definitions.label: AI budget ceiling per agency
definitions.description: The highest monthly AI budget an agency owner may set on Settings > AI. An administrator may give one agency its own ceiling here, and it wins over the agency's CRM plan. Without one, the plan's crm.ai_budget_usd_monthly (CIS Plans page, Tenant 360) is the ceiling when set, and this platform value when the plan gives none. Seeded at 2 USD (the old code default).

definitions.label: CRM AI: monthly cap per model connection (USD)
definitions.description: The CRM's own monthly AI spend cap on each model connection, by the connection's key in the CIS gateway registry, for example {"acc2": 20}. The CRM compares its spend of the UTC month (every agency together) with the entry of the connection its AI runs on: under the dev spend rules (crm.spend.environment) an AI draft is refused at the cap (write it by hand), under the prod rules the cap only logs. The CIS share of the same connection is its monthly budget in the CIS AI gateway; together the two must stay under the provider budget (CIS setting cis.spend.connection_provider_budget_usd), which CIS AI gateway > Budgets checks. A connection left out has no CRM cap. Read by app/llm/connection_share.py.

definitions.label: AI draft reply output token cap
definitions.description: Output token cap of every route entry of the crm_draft_reply stage (the only CRM AI stage that writes text); a reply cut at the cap is logged truncated and the draft says reply by hand. Seeded at 800 (the old Terraform and code value).

definitions.label: AI notes to options: closed list size
definitions.description: The most AA components (the agency's live AA tours and their parts in the trip's countries) offered to the model as the day's closed list; the model may pick only from this list and any other code is rejected.

definitions.label: AI notes to options: longest notes read
definitions.description: The longest notes text (the trip's own notes, newest first, or text the agent types) one AI notes-to-options run reads; older notes beyond it are left out, a longer typed text is refused.

definitions.label: AI notes to options: suggestions per run
definitions.description: The most AA options one notes-to-options run proposes for a day; extra picks of the model are dropped.

definitions.label: AI notes to options output token cap
definitions.description: Output token cap of every route entry of the crm_notes_options stage (proposing AA options for one proposal day from the trip's notes); an answer cut at the cap is logged truncated and the agent picks options by hand.

definitions.label: AI supplier confirmation: longest text read
definitions.description: The longest supplier confirmation text (a supplier e-mail on the trip's supplier request thread, or text the agent pastes) the AI reads in one run; a longer text is refused before anything is scrubbed or paid.

definitions.label: AI supplier confirmation: lines per run
definitions.description: The most agency lines of one supplier on one trip that one AI run may propose an update for (the closed list the model picks from); a supplier with more open lines is refused and the agent records them by hand.

definitions.label: AI supplier confirmation output token cap
definitions.description: Output token cap of every route entry of the crm_supplier_confirm stage (reading one supplier's confirmation into a proposed update of the trip's agency lines); an answer cut at the cap is logged truncated and the agent records the confirmation by hand.

definitions.label: Voice profiles per member
definitions.description: The most writing voices one agency member may keep for the AI reply draft (Settings > AI > Voices); a new one above it is refused until the member deletes one.

definitions.label: Campaign e-mails per mailbox per day
definitions.description: The most campaign e-mails one of the agency's own mailboxes sends in one day (agency timezone), all campaigns together; a longer list is spread over the next days. An administrator may give one agency its own value (for example a Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 mailbox that allows more).

definitions.label: Clients per campaign
definitions.description: The most clients one campaign may go to; scheduling a larger audience is refused until the agency narrows it with client tags. An administrator may give one agency its own value.

definitions.label: Member limit when CIS gives no seats
definitions.description: How many members (active, invited and pending invitations) an agency may have when its CIS account gives the CRM no seat number, and before the agency's first entitlement sync. Never above the member ceiling (the lower of the two applies). The seats CIS sells (crm.seats on Tenant 360) always win.

definitions.label: Member ceiling per agency
definitions.description: The most members one agency may have in the CRM, whatever seat number CIS sends (a larger number is cut to this ceiling). The database refuses more than 500.

definitions.label: Audit check: export behind after (minutes)
definitions.description: The ops check audit_export_lag e-mails when the hourly agency audit export is this many minutes or more behind (design v3 4.9: no partition can be dropped while an agency is behind). Read by app/observability/ops_alerts.py (the job sampler's tick, app/jobs/metrics.py).

definitions.label: Audit check: partitions needed ahead (months)
definitions.description: The ops check audit_partitions e-mails when fewer than this many future months have a crm.audit_event partition (without next month's, every audit write fails from the 1st). Read by app/observability/ops_alerts.py (the job sampler's tick, app/jobs/metrics.py).

definitions.label: Audit check: export not verified after (hours)
definitions.description: The ops check audit_verify_lag e-mails when an agency's exported audit has not been verified for this many hours or more. Read by app/observability/ops_alerts.py (the job sampler's tick, app/jobs/metrics.py).

definitions.label: Job check: running job overdue after (x its expected time)
definitions.description: A running crm.job attempt counts as overdue once it has run this many times its kind's expected seconds (app/jobs/kinds.py); the ops check jobs_overdue e-mails on any overdue job. Read by app/jobs/metrics.py.

definitions.label: Job check: queue stuck after (seconds)
definitions.description: The ops check jobs_stuck e-mails the platform alerts topic when the oldest due crm.job row has waited longer than this while no healthy job runs (the serial worker). It replaced the CloudWatch alarm on AA/Jobs/Crm queue age (S263); 900 s was its value. Read by app/observability/ops_alerts.py (the job sampler's tick, app/jobs/metrics.py).

definitions.label: Feed check: CIS membership feed stuck after (failed pulls in a row)
definitions.description: The ops check membership_feed_stuck e-mails (and logs crm_membership_feed_stuck) once the pull of the CIS membership feed has failed this many times in a row: CIS removals and agency locks no longer reach the CRM. Read by app/cis/membership_feed.py.

definitions.label: Overdue invoice reminder every
definitions.description: Days between two reminders of one overdue invoice to the trip owner (the first is the day after the due date). The CRM never writes to the client by itself; the agent chases.

definitions.label: Overdue invoice reminders at most
definitions.description: Reminders one overdue invoice gives the trip owner at most; 0 stops the reminders.

definitions.label: Refund owner-approval threshold of a new agency
definitions.description: A refund or cancellation-fee change above this amount (in the agency's base currency) needs the owner; an agent approves up to it. The value a new agency starts with, and the threshold of an agency with no settings row.

definitions.label: Staff sign-in: CRM operations staff must use an authenticator code
definitions.description: On: the AA-Partner API refuses an AA staff session that holds an operations group (crm-platform-admin, crm-ops, or cis-admin on the operations surface) when its sign-in did not use an authenticator app code, with 403 mfa_required (app/auth/admin_mfa.py reads the token's amr claim, which Amazon Cognito sets to include otp after a password plus authenticator code sign-in). Off (default): nothing is refused; such sessions are logged as staff_admin_mfa_check would_refuse, so the switch can be checked before it is turned on. Agency members (partner pool, MFA always required there), the support desk groups and the Dev-only test identities are never checked. CIS and Booking have their own switch.

definitions.label: AI calls per agency per minute
definitions.description: CRM AI gateway calls one agency makes per minute; above it a call is refused rate_limited before anything is scrubbed or paid. 0 turns the limit off. Seeded from the code default (6).

definitions.label: Submissions per inquiry form per hour
definitions.description: Submissions one inquiry form (and the Book now bookings of its key) takes per hour whatever the address, charged only after every other check; 0 turns the quota off. An administrator may give a busy agency its own quota. Seeded from Terraform (200).

definitions.label: Inquiry form and client page writes per address
definitions.description: Inquiry-form submissions and every anonymous client-page write (proposal page, sign-in code, Book now booking, hold, accept, pay) per client address per minute; 0 turns the limit off. Seeded from Terraform (5).

definitions.label: Requests per member per agency
definitions.description: Requests one member makes to /crm/v1 for one agency per minute (429 rate_limited above it), the same for every plan; 0 turns the limit off. Seeded from the code default (600; Terraform does not set it).

definitions.label: Public routes per address
definitions.description: Requests per client address per minute on the unauthenticated /crm/public routes and the health routes; 0 turns the limit off. Seeded from the Terraform value in force (60; the code default was 120).

definitions.label: Preview features for this agency
definitions.description: On: the agency app shows this agency the features still in preview and the preview entries of Help > What's new. Off by default; switch it on for one agency at a time, for an agency that agreed to try features early. A preview never changes privacy or price rules: those ship to every agency at once.

definitions.label: Audit partition drop: dry run
definitions.description: On: the daily audit retention only reports the monthly audit partitions past 12 months it would drop (both Object Lock copies stay). Off drops them, but only while Terraform's AUDIT_RETENTION_DRY_RUN floor is off too.

definitions.label: Job row retention: dry run
definitions.description: On: the daily crm_job_retention run only counts the finished crm.job rows it would delete. Off deletes them, but only while Terraform's JOB_RETENTION_DRY_RUN floor is off too.

definitions.label: Lifecycle deletes: dry run
definitions.description: On: every hard delete of agency data (submission redaction, LLM-call purge, trash purge, auto-archive, an owner's erasure or offboarding erase) only counts. Off lets them run, but only while Terraform's LIFECYCLE_DRY_RUN floor is off too (two keys: Terraform keeps a hard never-delete floor, tech lead S279 Q7).

definitions.label: Unused partner account clean-up: dry run
definitions.description: On: the partner-account clean-up only counts the never-used partner pool accounts it would delete. Off deletes them while Terraform's PARTNER_ACCOUNT_CLEANUP_DRY_RUN floor is off (it is today). Seeded off: today's effective value.

definitions.label: Global search in the agency app
definitions.description: On: the agency app shows the search box (Ctrl K) over the agency's clients (exact e-mail, phone or whole name through the blind indexes only), trips, bookings, suppliers, services and its libraries. Off by default; switch it on for one agency at a time, and only after the independent review of the search.

definitions.label: Shortest text search
definitions.description: The fewest characters a text search needs before it runs (an e-mail or an international phone number is always searched whole); a shorter term returns nothing.

definitions.label: Longest search term
definitions.description: The longest search term the agency app accepts; a longer term is refused before anything is read.

definitions.label: Search results per kind
definitions.description: The most results one search shows per kind of record (clients, trips, bookings, suppliers and so on); each kind runs one bounded query, so this also bounds the work of one search.

definitions.label: Two-person approval of CRM settings
definitions.description: On: a maker-checker CRM setting needs a second AA staff member to approve. Off (dev phase, tech lead S279 Q2): the administrator may approve their own change with a reason, and a high-impact change e-mails AA ops. Turn on at the first prod or paying tenant. This flag is maker-checker itself: while it is on, turning it off needs a second person.

definitions.label: CRM AI spend rules: environment
definitions.description: Which AI spend rules the CRM follows (tech lead policy S283). dev = hard caps everywhere: the CRM app's daily AI budget (AI gateway > App profiles) stops the AI drafts of every agency, and a spend that cannot be read stops them too. prod = pay per use: the app's daily budget only alerts and an unreadable spend lets the draft go on with a warning; an agency's own monthly AI budget (from its plan) always stops at its limit. Read by app/llm/spend_environment.py.
